_about: Content kept in data/gloss but left out of (or reworded in) the built app data by scripts/build_data.py, so the shipped text suits young children. Every rule must still match the gloss, or the build fails. See README > Hidden content.

hideSteinsaltz._about: Mishnayos whose Steinsaltz text (stIntro, st, stMore) is dropped. Their pieces then show only the simple meaning, with no Steinsaltz toggle.
hideSteinsaltz.3:1: Steinsaltz spells out forbidden relations (intercourse with relatives, a menstruating woman, incestuous and adulterous relationships).
hideSteinsaltz.3:12: Steinsaltz describes the flogging in detail (stripping the garments, baring the chest, the straps).
hideSteinsaltz.3:13: Steinsaltz describes the flogging in detail (lashes to the chest and back, struck with all his strength).
hideSteinsaltz.3:14: Steinsaltz describes death under the lash and the flogged man sullying himself with excrement or urine.
hideSteinsaltz.3:15: Steinsaltz twice names intercourse with forbidden relatives.
